mapper.select: select hr.*, m.name memberName from record hr left join member m on hr.memberid = m.id where hr.memberid = #{loginMemberId} order by hr.createTime desc
select * from record where id = #{id} and memberid = #{loginMemberId}
mapper.update: update record set temperature=#{r.temperature}, bpHigh=#{r.bpHigh}, bpLow=#{r.bpLow}, bloodOxygen=#{r.bloodOxygen}, weight=#{r.weight}, bloodSugar=#{r.bloodSugar}, remark=#{r.remark}, memberid=#{r.memberid} where id = #{r.id} and memberid = #{loginMemberId}
mapper.delete: delete from record where id = #{id} and memberid = #{loginMemberId}
